<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Circle</title>
  <style>
    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    :root {
      --bg: #f5f5f5;
      --circle: #1a1a1a;
    }

    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      :root {
        --bg: #111;
        --circle: #f5f5f5;
      }
    }

    html,
    body {
      height: 100%;
    }

    body {
      min-height: 100dvh;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background: var(--bg);
    }

    svg {
      width: min(400px, 80vmin);
      height: auto;
      display: block;
    }

    circle {
      fill: var(--circle);
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <svg viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img" aria-labelledby="circle-title">
    <title id="circle-title">A solid circle</title>
    <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="200"/>
  </svg>
</body>
</html>

Updated `/private/tmp/bvzbp/0.html`. The page still shows a single centered circle, with these improvements:

- **No horizontal scrollbar.** Replaced the fixed `100vw` width, which overflows when a vertical scrollbar is present, with a grid layout and `100dvh` so it also sizes correctly on mobile browsers.
- **Responsive circle.** The SVG now scales down on small screens instead of being locked to 400px.
- **Accessibility.** The SVG has an image role and a title, so screen readers announce it instead of skipping it. The page title is now readable text rather than a hash.
- **Dark mode.** Colors live in CSS variables and flip with the system color scheme.
- **Cleaner base styles.** Added border-box sizing and removed the unused element id.
